item.title: EBRPD board backs out of appointing Doyle to interim GM
item.description: Over two months since East Bay Regional Park District effectively parted ways with their general manager, the organization continues to operate without an interim leader given the Board of Directors’ unanimous decision at last week’s meeting to axe an agenda item for an appointment to the temporary post.
